gitCommit.body:
fix(books): founder 1oz bar — remove loan, cost sold bar at buyback price (#611)

* Morning routine 2026-10-23: playbook fold (A5 unchanged at 47) + record

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* CI: pin Playwright jobs to ubuntu-24.04 (ubuntu-latest moved to 26.04)

GitHub moved ubuntu-latest to Ubuntu 26.04 and Playwright 1.58.2 aborts with
"Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64". E2E failed in
under a minute, so every push to main went red and Deploy (hard-gated on
Tests) was blocked. Pin the four Linux jobs that run `playwright install`
(test.yml e2e-tests, uat, feature-showcase-capture, appstore-screenshots-
preview) to ubuntu-24.04, plus a guard test that fails if any Playwright
job floats on ubuntu-latest again (verified to fail on all four pre-fix).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* Inventory: 'house' source for founder-supplied stock; Money Map ignores cancelled consignment lines

The 1oz on order 991DA174 (inventory 757b68da) was mis-recorded as a
BullionKing consignment. The consignment line and PO-2026-0051 are
cancelled and the S$5,351.53 is booked as a founder loan (ledger
6816ad8d). The bar row still said source_type='consignment', so the
Money Map credited BullionKing and a reprinted packing slip would show a
BullionKing PO number.

- migration 20261023: allow source_type 'house'; re-point the one bar to
  house, source_id = the funding ledger entry (guarded; no-op on DEV)
- money-map: house -> 'House stock (founder)'; cancelled consignment
  lines no longer match an order item
- dispatch-preview: house -> 'House stock'
- InventorySource union + label

Admin/server only. No iOS impact.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* Books: strategic P&L simulator (retail) on live data

Replaces the unused Books simulator with Mukesh's brief: live spot, per-product
retail premium, cheapest landed cost, trailing Books opex (or an editable plan
figure), real order mix. Premium what-if with 4% floor flag, required premium,
sensitivity, delivery pricing grid, named scenarios. % values throughout.

Read-only against business data; writes only simulator settings/scenarios
(migration 20261023b, RLS + revoke). Admin-only, zero iOS impact (SDUI §214).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* Record 2026-10-23 day: house source, founder loan, P&L simulator

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* Simulator: Flow (swimlane) view + sub-headings in Detail

Adds a Detail | Flow switcher to Admin → Books → Simulator. The Flow view
draws the fulfilment flow as lanes (Customer → StoneX → Loomis → Airpak
warehouse → Delivery → Fixed costs) with cost cards per parcel or per
month, and a waterfall that reconciles to the Monthly P&L. Tapping a card
jumps to its inputs in Detail.

Detail now groups fulfilment inputs and P&L lines under sub-headings
(Loomis, Airpak, StoneX, Packaging, Payments & GST, Fixed costs) with
Airpak and Loomis subtotals. No engine change; admin-only, zero iOS.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* docs: record 2026-10-23 simulator Flow view close

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* docs: close 2026-10-23, move agenda to 2026-10-24 (MAG first)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* fix(inventory): reconciliation counts every bar inflow by current product

The gold reconciliation counted only PO receipts as received, so
consignment, house and buy-back bars were missing and moved bars were
counted against their old product. A GREATEST(0, ...) clamp hid the gap.

- received = every non-breakdown inventory row, by current product
- remove the clamp so a real gap shows its true size
- bundle SKUs no longer subtract their own sales (counted as pool_out)

Reporting only: no stock or ledger change. PROD dry-run: all 25 gold
rows reconcile, none negative. Admin-only, zero iOS impact (SDUI §216).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

* fix(books): founder 1oz bar — remove loan, cost sold bar at buyback price

Mukesh lent the 1oz PAMP bar to company stock; it sold on 991DA174 and the
company bought it back on buyback 952ffe2a and returned it to him. Nothing is
owed to him; the company keeps sale minus buyback (S$124.62). Removes founder
loan_in 6816ad8d and sets inventory 757b68da cost to the buyback price.
Guarded on exact current values, so a no-op on DEV and on re-run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016Wmy6syHUNbZveAD32f5UG

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
